speaker: richard_field
text: Thou art early, even for St James. Come up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The shoes would not wait on the feast. Both of them new-soled, and a heel-piece. Ninepence, in Bishopsgate Street.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Set the parcel on the table before you tell the rest. The cloth is clean.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A little book of fables, with woodcuts. Fourpence, at Paul's. For a girl who asked me in April for a book with no riddles in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And a paper of London pins. Twopence.

speaker: richard_field
text: Fourpence, and no riddles. She will have the pictures, and none of the cleverness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is what she asked. I am a quarter of the year late, and the book is small enough to carry.

speaker: richard_field
text: I have had word by the same carrier. My own kin are untouched.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the town was kinder than the first telling. None of ours is touched, nor any of us hurt.

speaker: richard_field
text: I heard twenty, and a malt-barn that was not yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty, and Sadler's cousin. Quiney is writing for a brief. That is her letter, and not the yard's forty.

speaker: richard_field
text: Thou'lt walk? A man with a share in a playhouse?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The horse was dear.

speaker: richard_field
text: The horse is always dear. Leave my Holinshed with me while thou'rt gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It lies under a cloth, and Mistress Ansell has her eye on it.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then let her keep the eye, and let the book stay. I will not have Holinshed on the road.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Sit. The stair is enough climbing before you have said the road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I sat at the cobbler's, and I sat at a stall. I can sit here.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then sit, and say the road once, so I have it from thee and not from a carrier.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday, on foot, by Banbury. I look to be at the bridge on Thursday, the last of July.

speaker: richard_field
text: On thy feet the whole of that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On my feet. Hobbins left at first light. He will be there four days before me.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Then the book stays, and the shoes are done, and you will not invent a third errand on my table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No third errand. The Holinshed stays under the cloth.

speaker: richard_field
text: Good. A share in a playhouse was never a horse. Thou hast said so without a speech.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Ninepence, fourpence, and twopence. I have heard the three.

speaker: richard_field
text: And the book stays. Say it once more, so the stair has it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book stays under the cloth. Mistress Ansell has her eye on it.
